title: “We Want to Breathe” anti-pollution protest at Sukhbaatar Square
organizer: Ch. Ganjavkhlan and others, as reported by iSee

threshold_50_evidence.summary: Opened iSee and Eguur bodies do not give a crowd count or clearly supported qualitative threshold. Petition signature counts are not attendance.

start_date.summary: Dec6 report calls it its second day; Dec5 is an inference.

end_date.summary: Dec7 body says protest dispersed after meeting; Dec8 search-only reports say protest paused, leaving the last-activity boundary unresolved.

organizer.summary: Ch. Ganjavkhlan and others; no broader organization established.

participants.summary: No attendance number or simultaneous group size reported.

state_response.summary: City council chair met organizers; no proof that requested policy changed.

protester_violence.summary: No violence account; unknown rather than no.

notes: iSee’s Dec6 report says the peaceful protest was in its second day; Dec5 is inferred as its start, not explicitly stated. It reports citizen Ch. Ganjavkhlan and others initiated it and planned to deliver demands on air pollution to Parliament, invoking the constitutional right to healthy, safe surroundings. Eguur reports the City Council chair met organizers and that the protest dispersed after the Dec7 meeting. Search-only Dec8 stories report that it would pause after enough signatures, but body text was not retrieved. End date is coded Dec7 as the last body-reported activity, with the Dec8 search-only account retained as an unresolved boundary issue.
open_questions: Is the Dec5 onset inference correct? Was attendance ≥50 at one time? Were several days one continuous protest episode? Did it physically end Dec7 or pause Dec8? What specific municipal/state action followed the meeting? Are any Jan2025 follow-up reports evidence of continuation?
